name: Scoop
text:
Decision: Focus today’s digest on the newest AI policy moves from the EU, U.S., and China—specifically the EU AI Act’s final trilogue text, the White House’s updated AI Executive Order, and China’s latest AI rules for recommender systems—all released within the last 48 hours.

Why: These three sources set the global tone for compliance, investment, and product roadmaps, so covering them first gives readers the clearest picture of where AI is headed next. Skipping any one would leave a gap that competitors will exploit.

Trade-off: We’re ignoring fresh but narrower company announcements (e.g., a single startup’s model update) to prioritize decisions that move markets and regulators. That means we’ll miss some breaking product news, but we gain authority and urgency for the audience that matters most.
